responsibility: Defines the per-machine-mode enablement and SEW/LMUL metadata used by the RISC-V vector backend. Through `ENTRY` records it states which RVV modes are available under the current minimum VLEN and ELEN/FP-ELEN capabilities and associates each mode with its LMUL and SEW/LMUL ratio interpretation, supplying compact mode-policy data consumed by the vector-mode and vsetvl machinery.
